lab.source: Chosen local test limits, reproducible seed and timeouts, not performance/heat measurements. No GPU needed; preserve other active workloads. World settings are initial defaults only.

measurement.source: Lab acceptance policy, not an instrument accuracy/confidence claim: capacity-regression electrical delta must exceed twice baseline drift, twice max normalized regression residual and 1 W. Raw WinRT mWh; exclude startup/world generation and require no players.
